description: Convert data between JSON and YAML in both directions. JSON to YAML parses with JSON.parse and serialises with js-yaml at two-space indent; YAML to JSON parses with js-yaml and prints with JSON.stringify. Runs on Hopi's server; nothing is stored. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/json-yaml-converter/
